coder_notes: Retifanlimab is the only investigational agent (Arms A and B). Temozolomide is given in arms B and C (soc_backbone) and omitted in arm A; its presence/absence is part of the design but not a new dose/schedule of an established therapy. Carmustine wafer is not a registered intervention but is placed at resection in every enrolled patient per the inclusion criterion. Arm C (labelled OTHER) is the standard-of-care control. All biomarkers are exploratory outcomes only; no entry requirement.
